title: Vyomaraj V16.9 — auto-align execution plan
scope: A finite completion path for every currently open platform-check item. Status does not become DONE without repository evidence; account access, owner decisions, installations, live connections and publishing are never performed by this runner.

steps.title: Run local verification sequence
steps.action: Run the allowlisted local-only sequence below and write timestamped evidence for the commands that ran.
steps.verify: python3 ops/vyomaraj-core/handover/auto_align.py --run
steps.done_when: All required local checks pass; unavailable preview routes are explicitly recorded as expected skips; the state file lists failures as zero.

steps.title: Verify the live preview when available
steps.action: Check the allowlisted viewer and gateway routes on the local preview ports; never start, stop or publish a service as part of this check.
steps.verify: The l09 and l13 checks in AUTO_ALIGN_STATE_2026_10_04.json.
steps.done_when: Each available route has its expected status and content marker, or a down preview port is recorded as SKIPPED_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE.

steps.title: Publish the reviewed branch
steps.action: After local checks and owner review, publish only arena/01a10655-vyomarajai and open a pull request. Do not merge automatically.
steps.verify: Read the branch head and pull-request checks from GitHub after the owner-approved publish action.
steps.done_when: The change is visible in a pull request from the required session branch and the PR records its checks; merge remains an owner decision.

steps.title: Select the secret manager
steps.action: Choose the approved secret manager, access owners and rotation procedure; record names and policy only.
steps.verify: Review the secret-manager configuration and access policy without copying secret values into the repository.
steps.done_when: The owner-approved manager, access policy and rotation evidence are recorded in the repository with no secret values.

steps.title: Resolve the governing contract record
steps.action: Identify which conflicting contract-status record governs and document the decision without deleting historical records.
steps.verify: Compare the candidate records, owner decision and their scope; retain a superseded-by pointer for the non-governing record.
steps.done_when: One governing record and its authority are owner-approved, with the conflict and retained history documented.

steps.title: Confirm accounts and plans
steps.action: Inventory the tool accounts, owners and selected plans needed for the approved work; leave unknowns explicit.
steps.verify: Review the account inventory and access boundaries; do not infer a price, plan limit or connected status.
steps.done_when: The owner has approved an account and plan inventory and each item has an evidence pointer or an explicit not-selected status.

steps.title: Clarify the recorded term
steps.action: Confirm what "posilki" means in the source note and whether it names a tool, person, workflow or typo.
steps.verify: Record the owner's exact interpretation and point to the source context.
steps.done_when: The term has an owner-confirmed meaning or is explicitly marked unresolved and removed from active setup assumptions.

steps.title: Configure research and drafting providers
steps.action: Review Perplexity, ChatGPT, custom GPTs, Claude and Gemini as separate owner-approved workflows with scoped access.
steps.verify: For each selected provider, record the account owner, allowed data, test result, failure behavior and reviewer without storing credentials.
steps.done_when: Every provider is either owner-approved and tested with repo evidence, or explicitly declined with a reason and no connection made.

steps.title: Configure media tools and rights evidence
steps.action: Review Canva, ElevenLabs, Animaker and CapCut; document approved stock and music sources with item-level rights evidence.
steps.verify: Test each selected tool using owner-approved sample media, consent records and export review gates.
steps.done_when: Selected tools and media sources have owner approval, documented rights/consent and a reviewed export path; unselected tools stay disabled.

steps.title: Configure publishing, scheduling and analytics
steps.action: Select destinations, account owners, scheduling rules, analytics scope and rollback behavior.
steps.verify: Review platform permissions and conduct a non-publishing dry run with an owner-approved test asset.
steps.done_when: Each destination has explicit approval, least-privilege access, a schedule policy and analytics evidence; no item is published by this plan.

steps.title: Exercise review gates with real media
steps.action: Exercise the approval path using real media selected and approved by the owner before enabling any publishing connection.
steps.verify: Record consent, rights, moderation, owner approval, rejection and rollback test outcomes.
steps.done_when: The owner signs off on the end-to-end review evidence and publishing remains disabled until that sign-off.

steps.title: Install the studio path
steps.action: Install and test the camera, voice path, mixer and cut room in the approved space.
steps.verify: Record device inventory, consent/access controls, signal tests and a reviewed handoff sample.
steps.done_when: Each studio component passes its documented test and the owner approves the handoff workflow.

steps.title: Deploy queue and event path
steps.action: Deploy the replicated queue and its event path with explicit ownership, idempotency, retry and recovery rules.
steps.verify: Run duplicate, delayed, retry, failover and restore tests; preserve their outputs as evidence.
steps.done_when: Queue and event tests pass on the intended failure domains and a documented restore procedure is owner-approved.

steps.title: Configure retrieval and memory boundaries
steps.action: Define RAG sources, CAG context rules and MAG memory boundaries per data class and agent.
steps.verify: Review provenance, retention, deletion, cross-workspace isolation and output attribution tests.
steps.done_when: All retrieval and memory paths have owner-approved scope, tests and rollback evidence; unapproved sources remain excluded.

steps.title: Scope workspaces and agent contracts
steps.action: Create least-privilege workspaces and reconcile per-agent contracts against the owner-selected governing record.
steps.verify: Test isolation and audit logging; compare every assigned agent's permissions to its approved contract.
steps.done_when: Workspace boundaries and contract assignments have owner approval, evidence and a tested revocation path.

steps.title: Configure Jarvis runtime and channels
steps.action: Design the Jarvis 24x7 service window and channels with an owner-controlled escalation route.
steps.verify: Test service restart, channel delivery, alerting, access revocation and safe shutdown.
steps.done_when: Runtime and channels pass their documented tests under owner-approved supervision and have a verified stop path.

steps.title: Deploy ShriYantra control services
steps.action: Define authority boundaries and deploy the ShriYantra control services with fail-closed behavior.
steps.verify: Test authorized, unauthorized, unavailable and rollback paths with an owner-approved test fixture.
steps.done_when: The authority matrix and test evidence are approved by the owner; a control failure cannot silently widen access.

steps.title: Establish independent DR and tested restore
steps.action: Provision a separate DR failure domain and run a complete restore from an owner-approved backup.
steps.verify: Record the independent-site identity, backup provenance, restore test, integrity results and limitations.
steps.done_when: The separate site and restore test are independently reviewed and documented; local two-lane evidence is not substituted.

steps.title: Define business window and real probes
steps.action: Set the business maintenance window, escalation ownership and real probe scope.
steps.verify: Run probes only with explicit owner authorization; record target, timing, safety boundaries and measured results.
steps.done_when: The business window is approved and each real probe has an auditable result with no production claim beyond its scope.

steps.title: Stage rollout and Hermes monitoring
steps.action: Define canary, stop and rollback gates; configure Hermes monitors and prove alert delivery.
steps.verify: Exercise the rollout and alert path on an approved non-production target before any production change.
steps.done_when: The staged rollout and alert evidence are owner-reviewed and the rollback gate has passed a controlled test.

steps.title: Define runtime intelligence and learning loop
steps.action: Set privacy scope, owner review, versioned evaluations and rollback criteria before activating runtime learning.
steps.verify: Review a reproducible evaluation set, data lineage, retention policy and rollback exercise.
steps.done_when: The owner approves the runtime-intelligence boundary and the measured learning loop demonstrates a reversible release.

local_sequence.purpose: Verify all open platform items still map to a completion step.
Verify the issue and PR ledger is current with its source data.
Validate the plan structure, safety and rendered page.
Run the complete offline Python, Node and builder suite; write evidence only after execution.
Verify the canonical handover note from its source data.
Verify the ownership and inheritance audit.
Verify the DR report from recorded evidence.
Check report-viewer routes when the local viewer is already running.
Check tracked text files decode as UTF-8 and contain no NUL bytes.
Verify the deterministic, non-secret handover package.
Check the working diff for whitespace errors.
Check gateway report routes when the local gateway is already running.
Check generated evidence for internally consistent counts without requiring it to predate the suite that wrote it.

safety.preview_policy: Preview checks are localhost-only and skip explicitly when the service is not already listening.
